==About==

7x {{i|Persimmon}}s may be Picked from a ripe {{i|Persimmon Tree}} during an {{i|Everbloom}}. A Persimmon will become a {{i|Rotten Persimmon}} if not used within a few days of being Picked. With the [[Fruit Orchards]] Skill learned, a Persimmon can be used to grow a Persimmon Tree when planted in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. Planting in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. NOTE: Fruit trees were originally seeded into the Newhaven map and found very rarely. The seeds for the corresponding trees were mostly either cut down or hoarded. It is unknown if there are still randomly spawned fruit trees in the wilderness or not. The fastest and easiest way to obtain fruit to plant as seeds is through trade with other players.
